info.name: AVF Vending Production (Full API)
info.description:
Full REST+gRPC+MQTT production suite. Writes blocked unless production guards enabled.

**Numeric folder prefixes:** Two-digit prefixes (00–35, 99) force stable sort order in Postman. REST domains use 01–29; gRPC 30–31; MQTT 32–35; utilities 99. gRPC/MQTT items are documentation/manual-setup entries (Postman v2.1 limitation).

item.name: 00 Overview & Runbook
item.description: Import order, numeric prefix meaning, safety guards, gRPC/MQTT manual setup. Auth: none.

item.name: README — Import and Safety
item.description:
# AVF Production Postman Runbook

1. Import environment, then collection.
2. Set adminEmail/adminPassword locally (never commit).
3. Run 02 Auth login; tokens captured automatically.
4. Production writes require allowGatedWrites=true AND confirmProductionWrites=I_UNDERSTAND_THIS_WRITES_TO_PRODUCTION.
5. gRPC folders 30–31 and MQTT 32–35 are manual Postman Desktop items (v2.1 limitation).
6. Numeric folder prefixes sort domains: REST 01–29, gRPC 30–31, MQTT 32–35, utilities 99.
